pages.text: “A cooling sensation down the throat, a gentle breeze against the skin—moving freely even through flames.”$(br2)Mint Tea is a refreshing and invigorating beverage made from two portions of dried mint leaves. The tea is crystal-clear with a revitalizing coolness. Drinking it grants temporary Fire Resistance and Speed, making travelers more agile and comfortable in harsh environments.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Mint Tea, $(br)boil two portions of dried mint leaves.$(br)It is best consumed in dangerous or high-temperature environments, allowing travelers to move confidently even through flames.

Upon drinking Mint Tea, travelers gain temporary Fire Resistance and Speed, enabling them to move more easily through fire and intense heat.$(br)This tea is ideal for exploring scorching regions, providing extra mobility and protection.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
